[[Image:River Sharia map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
The '''River Sharia''' is the river which forms the southern border of [[Amadicia]]. It rises out of the hills and mountains of the [[Shadow Coast]] south of [[Amador]] and flows east into the [[Eldar]].
